confirmedFindings.title: Malformed Q.850 Reason Header Format Breaks Parser
confirmedFindings.body: Omitting the whitespace in `Reason: Q.850;cause=16` breaks downstream regex parsers in cdr_pipeline/src/cdrIngestion.ts that expect RFC 3326 formatted `Q.850; cause=16`, resulting in unclassified call termination causes.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Format header per RFC 3326: `Reason: Q.850; cause=${q850Cause}; text="Normal Clearing"`.
